desc:
🏁 One car. Two players. Zero excuses when you miss the turn!

The DRIVER can't see the map. The NAVIGATOR holds the tablet and has to call every turn: LEFT! RIGHT! SHARP LEFT! STOP! Use voice chat or quick callouts and race the clock across forest, mountain and canyon stages.

But it's never that easy: mud splatters the windshield, doors fly open, the tablet gets knocked out of your hands… and yes, you can slap your partner when they mess up. 👋

🎮 MODES: Classic, Blindfold Run, I YELL (you navigate, the AI drives), Championship, Swap Seats and Speed Run vs the #1 ghost

🎨 Paints, wraps, horns, helmets, emotes and more
🤖 No partner? Race solo with an AI co-driver

Works on PC, mobile, tablet and controller!

( TAGS: Rally, Racing, Driving, Cars, Co-op, Multiplayer, 2 Player, , One Car, Shared Car, Team Driving, Co-op Racing, Multiplayer Racing, Rally Racing, Rally Car, Offroad Racing, Dirt Racing, Dirt Track )

Inspired By The Original Game Left Left Left!
